entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who returns to devastated Dominaria, loses his spark sealing the Shivan rift, and becomes a mortal wizard.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Teferi's companion who returns with him to Dominaria.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: A half-elf warrior who can draw mana from the Skyshroud rift and becomes Warlord of Keld.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: An artificer from Urborg with a latent planeswalker spark, creator of the ambulator.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker, protector and patron of Skyshroud, who transplanted the forest onto Keld and refuses to help Teferi.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: One of the Multiverse's oldest and most powerful planeswalkers, a dragon who regains corporeal form on Madara.

entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: An artifice-hating planeswalker who dominates Urborg.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The nexus of the Multiverse, nearly devoid of mana due to rifts.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: A continent Teferi phased out during the Invasion and which returns after three hundred years.

entities.name: Skyshroud
entities.description: A forest under attack by Gathans, transplanted onto Keld, with a rift over it.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: A land onto which Skyshroud was transplanted; Radha seeks to become a true Keldon here.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: A land where the Stronghold was transplanted and where Venser lives.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: A land where Jhoira, Venser and Radha wake on a beach.

entities.name: Ambulator
entities.description: Venser's teleportation device with a connection to the Urborg rift.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: The event during which areas such as Skyshroud and the Stronghold were transplanted.

entities.name: Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which Teferi phased Shiv out and left Dominaria.

entities.name: Gathans
entities.description: Attackers of Skyshroud, led by a warlord Radha defeats.

entities.name: Time Spiral Cycle
entities.description: The book cycle of which this novel is the first.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Device whose activation ended the Brothers' War, one of the events witnessed by the group.

events.summary: With Shiv's return imminent, Teferi and Jhoira return to Dominaria seeking information and aid, finding it nearly devoid of mana.
events.quote: Teferi first stops in Skyshroud but is horrified to learn that Dominaria is almost completely devoid of mana

events.summary: Freyalise refuses to help Teferi, angry over his abandonment of Dominaria during the Invasion.
events.quote: Freyalise refuses to help his efforts.

events.summary: Teferi meets Radha at the rift; she agrees to join him in exchange for ancient Keldon knowledge.
In Urborg the group meets Venser and Teferi senses both he and Radha have planeswalker sparks different from his own.
events.quote: Teferi can discern that both Radha and Venser have the planeswalker spark

events.summary: Venser's demonstration of the ambulator makes the rift react violently, and Teferi planeswalks into it; the whole group is pulled through the rift.
events.quote: the entire group is pulled into the rift falling through cracks in their reality

events.summary: Within the rift the group witnesses the events that caused Dominaria's rifts, including the Sylex and the obliteration of Tolaria.
events.quote: they witness the devastating events in Dominaria's history that caused the rifts plaguing the plane

events.summary: A disembodied voice tricks Venser and uses his and Radha's latent sparks to regain a body, revealing itself as Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: revealing itself to be Nicol Bolas

events.summary: Teferi duels Bolas and is easily defeated, but convinces Bolas of the rifts' dangers and Bolas leaves, swearing vengeance.
events.quote: Bolas decides to leave, swearing vengeance on those who had imprisoned him

events.summary: Radha defeats the Gathan warlord and becomes the new Warlord of Keld, shifting her rift connection to Keld.
events.quote: she becomes the new Warlord of Keld

events.summary: Teferi channels all his life force into the Shivan rift to close it; Shiv phases in safely but Teferi loses his spark and becomes mortal.
events.quote: Teferi is sapped of his planeswalker spark and is now mortal.

relations.quote: its protector and patron, the planeswalker Freyalise
is drawn into a duel with the dragon where he is easily defeated
Teferi and Jhoira return to Dominaria seeking information and aid
